headline: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments is now generally available, enabling autonomous transactions at scale.

items.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments is now generally available
items.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments has become generally available, allowing AI agents to perform transactions autonomously at scale. This system includes built-in spending guardrails and protocol-agnostic payment orchestration, alongside production-ready observability. The launch is aimed at ensuring safe, large-scale transactions for AI agents while minimizing risk and maintaining compliance.
items.why_it_matters: It enables tech leads to integrate robust, secure payment capabilities into AI agents, streamlining financial operations and enhancing autonomy.

items.title: Customize Amazon Quick embedded chat into your application
items.summary: Amazon Quick embedded chat offers developers the ability to integrate a conversational AI interface into their web applications. This tool provides customization options for container and SDK styling, branding removal, and personalized agent personas, ensuring the chat interface aligns with the application's brand aesthetics.

items.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
items.summary: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, an open model tailored for high-volume agentic workloads, is now part of Amazon SageMaker JumpStart. The model features a 30B Mixture-of-Experts architecture, offering up to 4x higher throughput and 30% faster task completion rates for demanding AI tasks.

items.title: Runtime Governance for Agentic AI
items.summary: This research paper discusses the implementation of runtime governance for agentic AI systems, focusing on action-boundary control and trusted provenance. It addresses the shift from managing harmful text generation to mitigating operational side effects, proposing a governance framework for safer agent operations.

all_items.summary: In this post, we describe how AIDA works at a high level and how it helps address these challenges — grounding users in the right contracts, under the right legal context, and within the right access boundaries.
